insights.title: Best and worst markets — GB turns installs into new subs best of anywhere (23.0% vs 11.7% overall).
insights.body: In GB, 23.0% of installs turn into new subs, versus 11.7% across all markets and apps (+11.3pp difference). That is much better than the rest — worth understanding and copying. GB is about 4% of revenue. Its App Total New Subs is -9.3% this period.

insights.title: Market trend — MX is gaining ground fast on turning installs into subs (+22.7%, now 9.5%).
insights.body: In MX, 9.5% of installs now turn into new subs — +22.7% versus last period. It is about 3% of revenue (a market worth watching): more of the people downloading are subscribing, which should help revenue within a week or two.
